title: Putnami Distribution Release Set v2
description: One immutable full snapshot of every artifact a publication produced. A member is keyed by (ecosystem, coordinate); the project it names is provenance, not identity. The ecosystem is an open identifier: the extension that owns the profile validates coordinate and version shapes, the protocol only bounds them. Identity is derived from the canonical projection and is not carried in this document.

ecosystem.description: An open ecosystem identifier. An extension declares the profile that gives it meaning; the protocol never enumerates the admissible values.

sourceRevision.description: The full lowercase hex commit the member was published from.

sourceTree.description: The full lowercase hex git tree of the checkout the member was built from. Two commits with the same tree hold the same content, so a consumer can recognize a publication whose commit a squash-merge or a rebase rewrote without changing the content. Provenance, never member identity. Absent on a set accepted before this field existed, and when the publisher could not read a tree that describes what it built.

selectionFingerprint.description: Derived from the deterministic execution key of the member's declared package step with its embedded version omitted, whether or not cache restoration is enabled. A later publication republishes any member whose fingerprint differs from its working tree.

project.description: The canonical logical id of the project that published this member, without a leading slash: the identity a selector names, which omits any folder that is transparent to identity and so is not always the physical directory path. Provenance, never member identity: the member key stays (ecosystem, coordinate) and one project yields any number of members. Absent on a set accepted before this field existed.

kind.description: The role the artifact plays, for a consumer that selects members by role rather than by coordinate. Absent when the publisher cannot classify the artifact, and on a set accepted before this field existed.

platforms.description: The SHA-256 digest of each os/arch artifact, so a resolver can verify one download without the whole index. Optional for every ecosystem.
